name: privacyscrubber/pii-masking-mcp
description: CISO-Approved Zero-Trust PII & Secrets Redaction MCP Server for Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Desktop. Prevent API leaks and comply with HIPAA/SOC 2 locally.

tools.name: sanitize_text
tools.description: STEP 1: Call this first. Locally scrubs PII, secrets, and credentials from code, logs, or text. Replaces them with safe placeholders (e.g., [EMAIL_1], [API_KEY_1]). Keep your data secure before passing it to any LLM.

tools.name: reveal_text
tools.description: STEP 3: Call this last. Restores masked tokens back with original private data from the local volatile RAM-only session map.

tools.name: audit_context
tools.description: STEP 0 (Pre-Flight): Non-destructive security inspection of raw prompts or document chunks before sending to LLMs. Evaluates PII, secrets, risk severity, and triggered regulatory frameworks.

tools.name: scrub_text
tools.description: Alias for sanitize_text.

tools.name: sanitize_file
tools.description: Reads a local file, sanitizes its contents using the selected profile, and outputs the safe version for AI analysis. Securely keeps original identifiers in memory.

tools.name: scrub_file
tools.description: Alias for sanitize_file.

tools.name: audit_directory_for_pii
tools.description: Scans a local directory for leaks of secrets, keys, and PII. Returns a structured security summary report.

tools.name: redact_file
tools.description: In-place redaction of a local file. Replaces PII and secrets with tokens and saves the file with an optional safety backup.

tools.name: create_default_config
tools.description: Creates a default privacyscrubber.json configuration file in current working directory.

tools.name: generate_compliance_report
tools.description: Generates an official Zero-Trust Compliance Audit Certificate (GDPR, HIPAA, EU AI Act, SOC 2) for the current MCP session.

tools.name: export_audit_log
tools.description: Exports an immutable, tamper-evident audit log in SIEM standard formats (CEF, Syslog, JSONL) with zero plaintext PII leakage.

tools.name: mark_false_positive
tools.description: Marks a previously detected token as a false positive, excluding it from future masking in the active session.

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Returns current PrivacyScrubber MCP tier, session usage, available profiles, and PRO upgrade instructions.

tools.name: guard_exec
tools.description: Zero-Trust Agentic Guard: Safely executes a shell/terminal command locally in isolated process, sanitizing stdout/stderr in volatile RAM before sending to LLM.

tools.name: guard_read_file
tools.description: Zero-Trust Agentic Guard: Reads a sensitive local file (.env, config, source code) and sanitizes credentials and PII in volatile RAM.

tools.name: guard_git_diff
tools.description: Zero-Trust Agentic Guard: Inspects unstaged or staged git diffs locally, sanitizing credentials and PII in RAM for safe AI commit generation or review.

tools.name: guard_apply_patch
tools.description: Zero-Trust Agentic Guard: Reverses token placeholders in AI code, restoring authentic values from RAM directly to the target file on disk.

tools.name: guard_unmask_args
tools.description: Zero-Trust Agentic Guard: Detokenizes parameters, JSON objects, or arguments in local RAM before dispatching to local tools or APIs.

tools.name: guard_session_info
tools.description: Zero-Trust Agentic Guard: Returns diagnostic metrics on active in-memory sessions and memory footprint with zero plaintext leakage.

tools.name: guard_session_reset
tools.description: Zero-Trust Agentic Guard: Explicitly purges the in-memory token map for a specific session_id or all sessions upon task completion.

tools.name: guard_rag_chunk
tools.description: Zero-Trust Agentic Guard: Sanitizes document chunks before sending to embedding models or vector databases (Chroma, Pinecone, Qdrant).

tools.name: guard_rag_restore
tools.description: Zero-Trust Agentic Guard: Re-hydrates retrieved vector search results by restoring token placeholders with authentic data from RAM.

tools.name: create_agent_rules
tools.description: Zero-Trust Agentic Guard: Scaffolds CISO-grade AI Agent Rules in workspace (.cursorrules, .windsurfrules, CLAUDE.md, copilot-instructions.md).

tools.name: generate_procurement_memo
tools.description: Zero-Trust Enterprise Procurement: Generates an executive-ready Procurement & ROI Memorandum for CISOs, DPOs, and VP of Engineering.

tools.name: secure_ai_workflow
tools.description: Zero-Trust Data Sanitization workflow instruction to automatically scrub PII before processing data.

tools.name: safe_redaction_workflow
tools.description: Instructions for using the redact_file tool safely with QA checks.

tools.name: agentic_guard_instructions
tools.description: Zero-Trust Agentic Guard instructions for autonomous AI agents (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code).
